notes.title: Quality of Life Fixes and New Achievement!
notes.content:
Hi, thanks for the continued support and feedback!

There are 4 main changes:

Holding down the upgrade button on ponds is faster now, making it more easily noticable.
The in-game achievement that was very hard to get has been removed. (Reach lv. 100)
Added a new achievement for unlocking the last fish!
Added an option to disable the sound effects of ponds, intended for late game usage.


-Skye
c:

notes.title: 1.0.2 Bugfix-patch
notes.content:
Increased max level limits of:
"Exponent" 10 -> 30
"Atomic converters" 10 -> 25
"Mad science" 3 -> 4
"Fishing trainers" 10 -> 20

Fixed a bug where mutations would sometimes be reset, and also still count towards the total.
Fixed a bug where DNA conversion required the menu to be open.
Increased DNA generation speed.

Thanks to everyone who has bought the game! :)
